iterations.finding: The remaining product problem was not a missing browser Fullscreen implementation but persistent chrome and legacy gutters consuming the apparent workspace.
iterations.resolution: Kept a single workspace state, removed the dynamic dock/gutter mechanics, and changed both the host shell and Native viewer chrome to compact overlays while retaining a clear Zurück action.

iterations.finding: Moving Native controls into overlays creates a new risk that fit-to-content can place diagram content directly under those controls.
iterations.resolution: Bound fit-to-content to VIEWPORT_FIT_PADDING = 48 and exercised fit/reset/edit reachability in the real-browser single-workspace regression.

iterations.finding: Maximizing Legacy and Native together could accidentally invent symmetric export capabilities or hide a capability that only one engine provides.
iterations.resolution: Preserved explicit engine truth: Native Canvas/source/original plus SVG and no PNG; Legacy Projekt plus PNG and SVG. Browser readback verifies these states separately.

iterations.finding: An opened Export popover remained visible after selecting an export, unnecessarily covering the canvas even though export succeeded.
iterations.resolution: The final functional revision closes the containing details element before starting Project/Canvas or PNG/SVG export; exact-head Native and Legacy readbacks prove the download still appears while the menu remains closed.

iterations.finding: Changing accepted implementation and test bytes invalidated several historical source bindings even though those historical receipts must remain immutable.
iterations.resolution: Added a new digest-bound max-canvas successor and restricted historical hash skips to the exact nine superseded paths, then passed the publication gate and the complete 1659-test suite on the clean evidence head.
